hero.subtitle: Designing and building digital experiences at the intersection of art and technology.

about.label: 01 — About
about.paragraph1: I'm a creative developer with a passion for building beautiful, functional, and accessible digital products. I believe great design is invisible — it just works.
about.paragraph2: My approach combines technical precision with creative exploration, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible on the web. Every project is an opportunity to create something meaningful.

contact.label: 03 — Contact
contact.paragraph: Have a project in mind or just want to chat? I'm always open to discussing new ideas and opportunities.
